content:
emma_s: Heads up — presales for NovaTrade. They want a POC that guarantees EU-only processing for tenant data, but allow APAC as a cold failover path (no persisted copies outside EU). BYO-KMS required and they attached a security questionnaire. Asking for delta pricing for dedicated vs hosted + egress estimates. Any immediate blockers?
lucas_p: High level: this is doable. We can set tenant-local routing + strict region affinity and an explicit failover to APAC that only accepts ephemeral requests and purges KV cache on failover. Need confirmation on which subprocessors they’ll accept (some customers reject any non-EU cloud subproc).
emma_s: They said no non-EU subprocessors by default, but might accept explicit attestation for certain vendors. Also: POC window is 4 weeks, needs an SLA note.
raj_k: Ops notes: routing to eu-west endpoints is straightforward. For APAC failover we can route to asia-southeast but mark data as transient and ensure KV/cache TTL=0 on failover. BYO-KMS: requires either customer KMS endpoint reachable from our VPC or peered VPC — expect added latency ~40-120ms for key unwrap depending on region. :eyes:
olivia_m: Pricing quick take: dedicated reserved pool (pinned capacity) ~25% uplift vs hosted for the same qps due to allocation inefficiency + failover standby. BYO-KMS integration is a one-time engineering onboarding fee (estimate to confirm). How steady is their load?
emma_s: They expect steady 40-60 rps with bursts up to 200 for 10-15m. Also want egress bucket breakdown by destination (EU internal egress vs cross-border).
secbot: Automated: subprocessor inventory (v3) available — internal link: https://redwood.internal/subprocs/v3 (internal). Attestations we have: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, EU SCCs; can produce a subproc exposure matrix and per-subproc country locations on request.
lucas_p: Example routing policy we can offer in the POC (config snippet):
```
route_policy: 
  tenant_affinity: eu
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  failover: 
    - region: ap-east-1
      mode: ephemeral
      kv_cache_ttl: 0
  allowed_subprocessors: ["redwood-core-eu", "partner-eu-logging"]
```
We'll present this as part of the technical handshake. Also propose a canary at 5% traffic for 24h.
raj_k: Ops checklist for POC: request customer CIDRs for firewall rules, schedule a 2h maintenance window for initial routing cutover, add smoke tests that assert no egress outside eu-west IP ranges, and request BYO-KMS test keys. Also note: for BYO-KMS over internet endpoints we need to add egress NAT band + monitor key unwrap latency.
olivia_m: I'll put a ballpark pricing note together: hosted baseline + dedicated uplift (~25%) + BYO-KMS integration fee (TBD) + estimated cross-border egress at current cloud rates. Will ping finance for precise egress buckets and send EOD.
emma_s: Perfect. Legal asked to be looped if they demand subproc exclusions — cc @legal. Last Q: do we have a fast attestation we can share for subprocessors during sales?
secbot: Yes — we can export a compact subproc CSV for sales with country and assurance level. Request via ticket: #subproc-exports.
lucas_p: Suggest delivering: 1) short tech matrix for POC (routing/pinning + failover behavior), 2) ops runbook (cutover + rollback), 3) pricing ballpark, 4) subproc CSV + attestations.
emma_s: Action items: 
- lucas_p: tech matrix + canary plan by tomorrow noon
- raj_k: ops runbook + firewall/CIDR template by tomorrow EOD
- olivia_m: ballpark pricing by EOD
- secbot: export subproc CSV (sales format) when ticket created
I'll update the customer and schedule a prep call for Tuesday. Thanks!
